{{recipesummary|category=Chicken recipes|servings=2|time=1 hour-
Marinating: 30 minutes
Cooking: 15 minutes|difficulty=2 }} {{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Poultry|Poultry]] ==Ingredients== * 1¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (420 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] canned [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], drained * 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]] * ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Italian Seasoning|Italian seasoning]], crushed * ¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic powder]] * 6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves ==Procedure== # Mix broth, tomatoes, cheese, Italian seasoning and garlic powder in a shallow non-metallic dish. Reserve half of this mixture. # Add chicken to remaining marinade and turn to coat. # Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. # Remove chicken from broth mixture. Discard the marinade. # [[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] or [[Cookbook:Broiling|broil]] chicken for 15 minutes or until done, turning and brushing often with reserved broth mixture.
